name: Ironclad
mechanic: Strength scaling, Exhaust, self-damage and healing.
act1: Exhaust tools double as answers to status cards (Slimed, Dazed, Infection, Wounds, Beckon).
Self-damage cards stack with enemy damage-over-time (Constrict, Infection, Beckon). Count it before you play them.
Strength makes multi-hit attacks better; multi-hit attacks are what strip Slippery quickly.

name: Silent
mechanic: Poison, Shivs (many cheap hits) and discard.
act1: Poison is not an attack, so it ignores attack-only effects such as Tangled and Shrink, and is not capped the same way by Hardened Shell (the wiki notes poison can add up to 20 more damage in a turn).
Many cheap cards and hits: strong against Slippery (Inklets, Vantom) and Slow (Bygone Effigy).
Discard lets you move status cards out of your hand before end-of-turn penalties (Infection, Beckon) trigger.

name: Defect
mechanic: Orbs (Lightning, Frost, Dark, Plasma, Glass) channelled and evoked.
act1: Orb damage is not an Attack card: it ignores Tangled, but also gets no bonus from Slow.
Lightning passives hit several times over a fight, which helps against Slippery and multi-enemy fights.
Frost gives steady Block, useful against enemies that scale with unblocked damage (Fossil Stalker).

name: Regent
mechanic: Stars as a second resource; Forge scales the Sovereign Blade.
act1: A single big Sovereign Blade hit is weak against per-hit caps: Slippery turns each hit into 1 damage, and Hardened Shell caps HP loss per turn.
Big single hits are strong against HP-threshold bosses (Ceremonial Beast, Terror Eel), where you want to cross the threshold on your terms.

name: Necrobinder
mechanic: Osty (summoned hand that attacks and absorbs damage) and Doom (enemy dies after its turn if Doom is at least its HP).
act1: The wiki notes that Waterfall Giant killed by Doom dies without exploding, and that Doom gets around Soul Fysh's Intangible.
Osty absorbs hits, which matters most against multi-hit attacks and large groups.
Not checked: whether Doom deaths count as losing HP for Slippery or Hardened Shell.
